messages.subject: "sequence item 0: expected string" error
parts:
Hi guys, 

I have an app running perfectly fine locally. When I try to deploy, I run into this error: 

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 37867...
Waiting for task: 25778296
  error: Parsing manifest
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 25778305 error: Unhandled Exception: sequence item 0: expected string, int found
Execution halted

I'm not sure what to change, as it runs perfectly fine locally...Anyone got any ideas?!

Thanks,

R
